name: Taisch
quote: Immerse yourself in fantasy and listen to the whispers of the spirits.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: (Yawn) Unh... Good morning, Caretaker. Another peaceful yet bizarre night has passed... Did you remember to feed the animals last night? Hm... Then, did you remember to feed me?

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: ...So sleepy. The zoo doesn't usually get visitors in the afternoon, so I'll let you decide what to feed the animals, Caretaker. I'm going to take a nap in my buggy, so don't let the animals run loose...

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: <color=#DE8AC7>"Welcome, dear Caretaker..."</color> Please don't get the wrong idea, it was Miss Bunny saying that. She cheers up a lot whenever she sees you at night. Truth is... so do I, hehe.

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: These things on my head are actually fluorescent lamp tubes. They're just shaped like bunny ears. I wear them so I don't have to worry about getting lost late at night. If you touch them, you'll get shocked... No, I'm not kidding. Caretaker, if you don't believe me, would you like to give it a try?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: <color=#DE8AC7>"Don't feed me garlic or onions!"</color> Miss Bunny seems really mad. Caretaker, you mustn't feed her stuff like that. Not at all. Not even once. Not ever.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: This is Arctic Fox. It's not an ordinary fox and it isn't a doggy either. If you hear it chuckling, please pretend you didn't hear anything. You understand, don't you?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: (Yawn) So sleepy... You look sleepy too, Caretaker...

voices.label: Home Screen 4
voices.text: Why do their pets have that kind of look on their faces? Am I actually scary or something? Hm... I don't get it.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: Today's to-do list was empty as well... Want to go out and play with Arctic Fox and Miss Bunny? I brought balloons.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: I told you, they're not bunny ears, they're lamp-bulbs... Quit pinching them. If you get shocked, it's all on you.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: Hehehe... Miss Bunny's so fluffy and cute that she looks just like a real bunny, right? ...Huh? "A real bunny"?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: It's not good to get over-excited, Caretaker. Looks like you need to cool~ your~ head~

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: If you feel tired during your shift, go get some sleep with Miss Bunny on the buggy.

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: I'm Taisch, and this is Miss Bunny. We used to work in a zoo that nobody visited. If you don't mind, please let me call you "Caretaker".

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: (Yawn) I should be less sleepy now.

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: Just as planned...

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: We can bring new exotic animals into the zoo now, like giraffes, African elephants, and... Hehehe.

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Battle, hm... Then I'll let you take care of the animals for now, Caretaker.

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: Ugh... I can smell something threatening.

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: Taisch is here.

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: Were you watching me, animals?

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: This scenery is so weird.

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: Is this... the end...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text:
Hm? Are you sure, Caretaker? Um, please wait a minute, I need to discuss this with Miss Bunny...
...Ahem, there's a really important announcement I'd like to make today! At your enthusiastic request, Caretaker, you'll take responsibility for managing the zoo with me. I can't let you slack off by yourself since you've come this far, after all. <color=#DE8AC7>"Please take us too."</color> That's what Miss Bunny and Arctic Fox said just now, as well as the giraffes, the African elephants, the goats... and everyone else, too.

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: In the East, people name the years after 12 animals. Come to think of it, you can find those 12 animals in my zoo. I spent two weeks on a new outfit to welcome the new year... Caretaker, which year is this one? Let's change into something new together.

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: Valentine's Day, hm. I remember there used to be a zoo that had a weird Valentine's Day event where you could "name a praying mantis after your ex". Why didn't they use a cuter animal... Ah, we've got an event today too. Since we're the only two in the zoo right now, it'll be a special exclusive event just for you—chocolate, for you. Huh? You've got a gift for me too? ...Thank you, Caretaker.

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: I don't quite understand Tanabata. About the only thing I know is that lots of visitors who appear to be couples go to the zoo for dates on this day... That said, my zoo doesn't have any visitors today. In that case... let's pretend to be visitors together, Caretaker. We'll set off fireworks, and then....<color=#DE8AC7> "Hold Taisch's hand tight and don't get lost!" </color>Ah, that's what Miss Bunny said... Well, come on then, Caretaker.

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text:
<color=#DE8AC7>"I am Miss Bunny, the magician that hops between the bushes. That's the white demon wolf... Arctic Fox. And on this night of myriad spirits..."</color>
What were those weird things Miss Bunny was saying? You look so weird when you're confused, Caretaker. It's really cute... Still, that's okay. Speaking of which, can you help change the zoo's sign to the Halloween-themed one? I can't quite reach it... Uwah!

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: Actually, I've always wanted to raise a reindeer, so I went looking for Santa's sleigh whenever Christmas came along each year, but I never managed to find anything... Hm? I'm wearing a strange outfit today? It's a limited-edition Christmas-only uniform, which should be able to draw in visitors. Do you think it looks ugly, Caretaker?

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: (Yawn) Happy birthday, Caretaker. I'm feeling sleepy today, so I decided to record my well-wishes and had Miss Bunny send them over with my gift. This way, you'll be able to hear me wish you a happy birthday as many times as you want... zzz...

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural... Cloud?

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text:
The Oasis is more peaceful than I expected, or at least it seems that way. Still, did the Oasis not even have something as basic as a zoo before I came? Or rather, it's because I'm here that the workers at the Oasis now have another option for relaxation, right... Make sure you come to the zoo to visit.
Huh? People think my zoo is weird? Even you're saying that, Caretaker? ...Well, a lot of people have been saying that too... Could that be the reason why we haven't been getting any visitors...

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text:
About my past, hm... Well, it all seems foggy in my head. Even I don't remember what I've been through before.
I found myself in an abandoned zoo, and I took on the responsibility of looking after that place with Miss Bunny and Arctic Fox who suddenly appeared. I gradually came to learn how to run a zoo, so even if nobody visited, I could still take care of it. However, the animals seemed to be ...&...()*&)()*+—)
Huh? What did I say just now? Please forget about it, Caretaker.

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text:
In reality, I only did three things each day: take care of the animals, study certain creatures that only existed in stories, and sleep.
There was nothing else to do but sleep in a zoo that nobody visited. What drove me were those animals that might not even exist. That's why I kept chasing their trail... What exactly was it that was affecting me? I never received any clear instructions, and I couldn't find any answers in my neural cloud. Perhaps that was supposed to be part of my responsibilities... But then, why was I created?
(Yawn) The more I think, the easier I crash. I should just stick to researching fantasy animals. See, I've collected all the files I could find about alicorns. The pile is about as tall as I am now.

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
Caretaker, do you know what the name "Taisch" means? In Scotland, it refers to "a spirit lingering in the world"... Imhotep once said that "Both your body and personality are as fleeting as a ghost." Although I don't know why I was given this name, I've always wanted to find out where it came from, but I've never been able to learn anything about it.
Well, I say I'm curious, but "searching for the origins of a mysterious name" would probably be really troublesome. Still, if you're willing to search for it with me, I don't mind giving it a try.

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
Caretaker, did you learn something you shouldn't again? It's not like this is the first time... Oh, no need to go out of your way to forget it. You've grown used to how weird I am, right? Just like how I know you ought to be the "Professor", but I keep calling you "Caretaker" instead. It's okay if you know about mysterious things like how Miss Bunny and Arctic Fox are actually artificial creations like me...
Speaking of which, I'm sure you'll have no problem living with me in the zoo, Caretaker. Even if I never learn the truth regarding the mysterious things about me, that's okay... I think.
<color=#DE8AC7>"I'm hungry!"</color> It seems it's feeding time for Miss Bunny. Shall we get her and Arctic Fox something to eat? Actually... I'm also hungry.

voices.label: Praise
voices.text: Interesting.

voices.label: Sympathy
voices.text: OK.

voices.label: Dissatisfied
voices.text: Hmm…

voices.label: Laugh
voices.text: Hehehehe...

voices.label: Surprised
voices.text: Mhm?

career:
The ZM line of zookeeper Dolls was independently developed by UAS. It featured the ability to raise and care for various kinds of animals, maintain and manage zoo premises, act as a tour guide for visitors, and perform other professional skills. Individual ZM units could also be fine-tuned to better meet the needs of different zoos. The ZM56 series was produced relatively early in the line's history. As it was marketed toward family and petting zoos, it featured a child-like appearance and a simulated personality, making it suitable for interacting with younger patrons.

Taisch is a special example of the ZM56 series. She was originally custom-tailored for a private client but was later resold to a newly opened zoo. After the zoo went bankrupt and closed down, Taisch was left behind as part of its assets. UAS recovered her some time later and then transferred her to Project Neural Cloud.
infoStories:
The ZM series of Dolls was born from a zoo's need for a workforce that was competent in multiple fields. In an age where labor was in short supply, the costs of hiring multiple employees to cover various functions grew steadily higher. Dolls, with their flexible capabilities and broad adaptability, were seen as the solution to this dilemma. To address this niche in the market, UAS started the ZM series project for an animal husbandry Doll. The earlier models produced by this project were simple manual laborer types, equipped with high-spec sensory modules, computation modules oriented toward animal husbandry and veterinary medicine, as well as data models containing animal handling information. When it came to dealing with dangerous animals, handling boring and repetitive manual labor, and other such tasks, these professional zoo management dolls proved to be superior to human beings.

As more and more orders poured in with specific requirements, the ZM series also had client-interfacing, venue management, and other such functions added to them, which led to many derivative models being created. Among them was the family-oriented ZM56 series, which was equipped with neural cloud systems and a body modeled after a human child. In terms of functionality, the ZM56 retained the standard array of capabilities required for zoo work but lost much of its function upgrade capacity as a result, and its ability to handle adult guests was poor. The excessively small niche market also meant that very few ZM56s were purchased.

Due to the designated role of the ZM series, most of them were purchased by corporate entities. The sole exception to this rule was a particular ZM56 unit that was customized to the specifications of an older woman. Little is known about this special buyer, but the limited information available suggested that she was struck with an intense urge to purchase one after seeing the promotional material for the ZM56 Doll series.

During the customization process, the buyer requested several adjustments to be made to the Doll's neural cloud and named her "Taisch". After purchasing Taisch, the buyer arranged for her to undergo further aftermarket modifications to address the issue of the ZM56 having too little neural cloud memory, as well as custom-making a pair of mechatronic animal companions for her. It was speculated that this was when Taisch's love of fantasy creatures was incorporated into her neural cloud—but that was merely speculation, of course.

However, Taisch was soon resold on the second-hand Doll market not long after being purchased. In turn, those new buyers sold her to a zoo at a low price. According to Taisch's purchase and transfer records, the old lady who initially commissioned her was likely to be deceased.

Taisch's new workplace after being resold was a themed zoo that kept biosynthetic mechatronic animals. Her job scope there included facility management, guiding visitors around, caring for the animals, and performing tasks that adults would have a hard time completing, such as managing child visitors and maintenance work in cramped spaces.

During the early stages of her employment, Taisch encountered common problems faced by other members of the ZM56 series; namely, her bland facial expression and childlike appearance made it difficult for human workers and certain guests to take her seriously. However, after several incidents when she managed to soothe distraught children, her calm demeanor, practical work attitude, and her ability to manage younger visitors slowly won her the approval of her colleagues.

When the zoo first opened, it gained much attention for its use of biosynthetic animals. However, as the company's direction gradually began to shift behind the scenes and the zoo division slowly lost support, the business begin declining. Despite Taisch's excellent professional skills, she could not save the zoo from its operational crisis. Fewer and fewer visitors were coming, profits were dropping, and several accidents led to public opinion turning against the zoo. After attempts to expand the premises and host events proved fruitless, the company announced that they were abandoning the enterprise and decided to liquidate the zoo.

The high cost of demolishing or continuing business on top of the zoo's remote location made it difficult to sell the property, and thus the company decided to shut it down and abandon it. As part of the zoo's assets, Taisch and the mechatronic animals were also abandoned with it. Taisch's low neural cloud capacity meant that her neural cloud had been formatted many times during the course of her employment, and after the zoo went bust, Taisch was once again cleared of all data by the staff before they left.

When Taisch awoke again, all she saw was a run-down zoo that was closed for business. Without human workers to answer her questions or instruct her, Taisch had no idea what had happened. All she could do was follow the base layer commands she had been programmed with and continue caring for the mechatronic animals in a zoo that had no visitors. Thanks to her diligence, the animals initially managed to carry on in good condition, until more and more of them had to be written off due to the lack of proper maintenance.

This state of affairs lasted for several years until Taisch's zoo, now bereft of anyone, became the subject of urban legends which spoke of strange creatures running through abandoned buildings and a ghost-like child who seemed to walk its halls. After UAS learned about the matter, they brought Taisch back in and performed a basic diagnostic on her.

Her long solitude had left Taisch with quite a few bad segments in her neural cloud, which had ended up fusing with her mechatronic animal assistants. The likelihood of a complete recovery seemed low, and due to the ZM56 production line being shut down, Taisch was sent to 42Lab to take part in Project Neural Cloud as the sole surviving representative of her series.

After coming to the Oasis, Taisch became the subject of heated debate due to her unique nature. In order to help stabilize her neural cloud, the Professor had the Engineering Department set aside a small area to be her new workplace in the Oasis. However, "The Oasis Zoo's" spooky atmosphere and mysterious keeper led to it becoming the subject of an urban legend circulating on the Oasis forums. In truth, the small size of the zoo and lack of visitors meant that Taisch's zoo was largely empty, but that much was enough for Taisch. Perhaps she had found joy in things beyond caring for animals and collecting data on fantasy creatures.

"Hm... Taisch appeared behind Max without a sound and gave Max such a scare that she almost jumped out of her skin... For some reason, Taisch seemed to be enjoying herself..."
—The Oasis Zoo Visitor Log
oathDesc: From now on, she'll never be alone.

projections.name: Little Zookeeper
projections.desc:
Attire produced with a Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"Do you want to tour the zoo with Miss Bunny? I'll come with you."

projections.name: Little Zookeeper
projections.desc:
Attire produced with a Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"Do you want to tour the zoo with Miss Bunny? I'll come with you."

projections.name: Mysterious Maintainer
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with a Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"The zoo will close in half an hour. All guests who haven't left yet should leave now. (Sigh) That said, there's nobody on the grounds today either."

skinList.name: Moe Moe Assault Squad
skinList.desc: The surging fighting spirit that swells between each intense battle is what keeps each Doll going until the very end. Be it on the attack or defense, no matter how good or bad the situation is, their memories have been reproduced in Magrasea through this projection. "Shhh—Bear with it, everyone. The enemy's going to show their weakness soon. When that happens, jump down from the roof and let them have it with your claws and fangs!"
